title: Free Haircuts are Boosting Back-to-School Confidence
description:
Looking good helps students feel good, and local leaders are making sure every child starts the school year with confidence.

The Happy Pappy Foundation recently hosted a lively back-to-school event in the San Fernando Valley. Top hair stylists volunteered their time to give children free, gender-affirming haircuts. Families also received free backpacks, meals, and raffle prizes.

A sharp haircut offers more than just a neat appearance. It boosts self-esteem and helps children make strong first impressions on their classmates. This nonprofit aims to lift up underserved communities through personal support, mental health resources, and art.
